target: DOE SPARK grid transmission initiative (31 projects
theme: DOE Office of Electricity's SPARK (Speed to Power through Accelerated Reconductoring and other Key Advanced Transmission Technology Upgrades) initiative selects 31 grid-reconductoring/upgrade projects across 26 states, replacing/rebuilding 1,500+ miles of transmission lines and upgrading ~21,000 miles, adding ~23GW of capacity. Announcement explicitly framed around AI/data-center-driven electricity demand growth. $1.9B is DOE's committed share; recipients add $3.35B in cost-share (round_total_usd = combined $5.25B per TD World/Daily Energy Insider). Corroborated independently by Bloomberg (energy department earmarks $1.9bn) and TD World/Daily Energy Insider ($5.25B combined figure). No single named target company -- project is a multi-recipient DOE funding-opportunity selection, not yet individually negotiated award agreements per project (consistent with DOE's usual OEDF/FOA sequencing), so treat as selection-stage capital commitment rather than fully disbursed cash.
